title: Syracuse University Board of Trustees chose ex-Goldman Sachs exec as next chairman
summary: Syracuse University's Board of Trustees appointed a former Goldman Sachs partner and alumnus as the new board chairman. This leadership change at a major regional institution may have implications for Syracuse's business-community engagement and economic development partnerships.

political_signal.description: Appointment of finance sector executive to university leadership suggests potential alignment with business-community priorities and economic development initiatives in Syracuse region
